hero.title: Handball Quiz Management System
hero.subtitle: Create and manage handball rule quizzes for referees and delegates of the Belgian Handball Federation

about.title: Quiz Session Management System
about.description: This application manages handball rules quiz sessions. Administrators can create quiz sessions in bulk for multiple users, send email invitations, track session progress and completion status, filter and sort sessions by various criteria, and view performance analytics including scores and completion rates. Quizzes support 4 languages (English, Dutch, French, German).

bulk.title: Bulk Session Creation
bulk.description: Create quiz sessions for multiple users at once. Each session is assigned to a specific user with unique tracking capabilities.

management.title: Session Management
management.description: Track quiz sessions through their lifecycle: pending, in progress, completed, or expired. Filter and sort by status, date, score, or user email. Send invitations and manage all session actions.
